---
title: "Ezra"
---

# Ezra

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Ezra records the return from exile and the rebuilding of the Temple. The book emphasizes God's faithfulness in restoring His people through worship and obedience to His Word.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Who is among His people? Let him go up</div>

### Why This Verse

Return from exile begins

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Cyrus's decree allowing the Jews to return to Jerusalem. The key verse demonstrates God's sovereignty in moving rulers to fulfill His promises.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 2:64</div>

<div class="identifier">The whole congregation together</div>

### Why This Verse

Summary of returnees

### Chapter Insight

This chapter lists those who returned from exile. The key verse emphasizes God's faithfulness in preserving a remnant for restoration.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 3:11</div>

<div class="identifier">For He is good; His mercy endures forever</div>

### Why This Verse

Temple rebuilding worship

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the rebuilding of the altar and restoration of worship. The key verse highlights the priority of worship before reconstruction.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 4:4</div>

<div class="identifier">The people weakened the hands of Judah</div>

### Why This Verse

Opposition to the work

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records opposition to rebuilding efforts. The key verse demonstrates that God's work often faces resistance from adversaries.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 5:5</div>

<div class="identifier">The eye of their God was upon them</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine protection

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the resumption of Temple construction through prophetic encouragement. The key verse emphasizes the power of God's word to renew obedience.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 6:14</div>

<div class="identifier">They prospered through the prophesying</div>

### Why This Verse

Completion of the temple

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the completion and dedication of the Temple. The key verse celebrates God's faithfulness in bringing His work to completion.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 7:10</div>

<div class="identifier">Ezra prepared his heart to seek the Law</div>

### Why This Verse

Defining verse of Ezra's ministry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces Ezra and his mission to Jerusalem. The key verse highlights Ezra's devotion to studying, obeying, and teaching God's law.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 8:23</div>

<div class="identifier">We fasted and sought our God</div>

### Why This Verse

Dependence through prayer

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Ezra's journey and God's protection. The key verse demonstrates dependence upon God rather than human security.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 9:6</div>

<div class="identifier">O my God, I am ashamed and blush to lift up my face</div>

### Why This Verse

Ezra's confession

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Ezra's grief over Israel's sin. The key verse emphasizes genuine repentance before a holy God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Ezra 10:4</div>

<div class="identifier">Arise; for this matter belongs unto thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to decisive action

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the people's response and covenant renewal. The key verse highlights repentance expressed through decisive obedience.
:::
